title: Get Parameter
text: Get values from ROS parameter server, 3 outputs, {Show ErrorCode output port} sets Display error code output on; {Source}, {Name} sets the parameter name string, {Data type}, {Maximum length}, {Initial value} sets the default parameter value and {Sample time} sets the interval between outputs. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Value
ports.summary: Parameter value scalar | logical | uint8 array

params.values: Source for specifying the parameter name Select from ROS network | Specify your own

params.values: Data type of your parameter double | int32 | boolean | uint8[] (string)

params.values: Maximum length of the uint8 array scalar
